## Local additions

- `include/ogg/config_types.h`: `config_types.h.in` configured as upstream's `CMakeLists.txt` configures it on a C99
  platform (`INCLUDE_INTTYPES_H`, `INCLUDE_STDINT_H` and `INCLUDE_SYS_TYPES_H` 1; the `ogg_int16_t` to `ogg_uint64_t`
  typedefs the `<stdint.h>` types), with a comment saying so. CMake writes it into its build tree; `os_types.h`
  includes it only on platforms it does not list itself (Linux among them), so MSVC and macOS never read it. SHA-256
  `bc6a111bd92c81efaa38988e2f6e8c575049bc5524666e3f795efdcb3d627522`.
- `premake5.lua` and this file.

## What it is for

The Ogg container (page framing and the bit packer) under opusfile (`Vendor/opusfile/VENDOR.md`), which miniaudio's
libopus decoding backend (`Vendor/miniaudio/VENDOR.md`) reads Ogg Opus files with: M23's Ogg Opus import (A-OPUS,
`Docs/Decisions/0034-m23-contract.md` decision 16). No first-party code includes its headers; the engine's own Ogg page
checks (`Audio/AudioDecoder.cpp`) read the bytes themselves.

## Build configuration (`premake5.lua`)

- Files: upstream's `OGG_HEADERS` and `OGG_SOURCES` (`CMakeLists.txt`), with the configured `config_types.h`. Include
  directory `include` (upstream's public one). `win32/ogg.def` (the shared library's exports) is not needed for a static
  library.
- Defines: none. libogg has no configuration macros; `os_types.h` chooses its integer types from the compiler's own
  macros.
- C dialect and warnings: the compiler defaults (upstream sets neither); the library compiles without warnings under
  MSVC 14.51 at the workspace's level for vendored code (`/W3`).
- Linux: `pic "On"`. Debug: `symbols "on"`; Release: `optimize "on"`, `symbols "on"`; Dist: `optimize "full"`,
  `symbols "off"`.
- The Linux and macOS builds are generated by the portability stage and never compiled (ADR 0028 decision 10).

## Consumer usage

```lua
-- Dependencies.lua: UseOgg(), called by UseMiniaudio() after UseOpusFile() and UseOpus(): links only.
filter { "kind:ConsoleApp or WindowedApp or SharedLib" }
    links { "ogg" }
filter {}
```

Vendored consumers (`Vendor/opusfile`, `Vendor/miniaudio`) add `../libogg/include` to their include directories and
include `<ogg/ogg.h>` with no defines. `Scripts/CheckBuildConfig.py` compares only `NDEBUG` for libogg (an empty
family).

## Updating

1. Download the release tag's archive from `https://github.com/xiph/ogg/archive/refs/tags/<tag>.tar.gz`, record its
   SHA-256 and size, and extract it into an empty directory.
2. Replace the kept files above, re-run the configuration of `config_types.h` against the new `config_types.h.in`, and
   diff `CMakeLists.txt`'s `OGG_HEADERS`, `OGG_SOURCES` and definitions against `premake5.lua`.
3. Rebuild Debug, Release and Dist, run the `AudioDecoder*` and `AudioImporter*` unit cases (the Opus digest among
   them), and update this file.
